text: Profit growth concentrates in AI, semiconductor, and high-tech manufacturing nodes, while raw material and energy costs rise across the system. Output coherence persists as gains cluster in select sectors. Input pressure increases system-wide, but production continuity remains intact through uneven load distribution.

meta.note: Expansion and compression co-occur across different layers, creating classification tension.

text: A cross-border acquisition involving an AI firm is halted through regulatory intervention, preventing ownership transfer across jurisdictions. Control over the asset remains within the originating system. External capital access pathways are restricted, and the transaction channel is effectively closed.

meta.note: Contest inferred from dual regulatory pressure across jurisdictions without explicit simultaneous claim resolution.

text: A major energy firm absorbs a smaller producer, increasing total controlled production capacity and integrating assets into an existing portfolio. Output volume rises under unified control, while resource flows and operational load shift toward the acquiring structure.

meta.note: Expansion and redistribution occur simultaneously as capacity increases while control centralizes.
